svg.title: Drishti*net on ECS: a new node finds its seeds
svg.desc: drishti-c starts with Cloud Map seed names, writes peer files, resolves a real address and gossips; every member then lists it.

svg.text: entry point writes config/net/peers/drishti-a.yaml and drishti-b.yaml

svg.text: server resolves drishti-a.drishti.local → 10.0.1.23 (a real address; loopback would be refused)
